questions.stem_text: Which of the following presidential powers is shared with the Senate?

Which of the following most accurately describes the right of American citizens to
privacy?

options.A: The right to privacy is determined entirely by the states on a case-by-case basis.
options.B: The right to privacy is explicitly granted in the Preamble to the Constitution.
options.C: The Supreme Court has ruled that the right to privacy is implied by the Bill of Rights.
options.D: Common law requires the government to respect citizens' right to privacy.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The Supreme Court has ruled that the right to privacy is implied by the Bill of Rights.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following statements is the odd one out?

options.A: Societal groups have a right to survive.
options.B: Societal groups have their own reality.
options.C: Societal groups are constituted by social interaction.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Societal groups are constituted by social interaction.
